answer: Audits are published in meadow, queued in wander, and knoll publishes the wait time. A farm of 115 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 74 identities per epoch. A farm of 2916 identities would post 2843 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
